commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "sha256sum materials/scenarios.csv
nl -ba materials/scenarios.csv
awk -F, 'NR>1 {rev=4*"'$2*$6; var=4*$3*$6; fixed=$4+4*$5; profit=rev-var-fixed; printf "%s: revenue=%.0f variable=%.0f fixed_plus_setup=%.0f result=%.0f'"\\n\","'$1,rev,var,fixed,profit} NR==2 {fixed4=$4+4*$5; contrib4=4*($2-$3); printf "subscription break-even exact=%.6f, whole_accounts=%d'"\\n\",fixed4/contrib4,int((fixed4+contrib4-1)/contrib4)}' materials/scenarios.csv"
